args.rationale:
The recommended purchase of 800 units for SKU-1002 at NODE-BOG-F2 is correct and accepted.

Current usable stock is 380 units with 0 open purchase orders. Daily forecast demand is 35 units per day (980 units over the 28-day planning horizon). Without action, the baseline projection indicates inventory exhaustion and a stockout beginning 2026-09-27, resulting in 600 units of total unmet demand.

To meet the horizon demand of 980 units and maintain the required safety stock level of 200 units, exactly 800 units are needed (980 total demand + 200 safety stock - 380 usable stock = 800 units needed).

Supplier SUP-A offers a unit price of $12.00, MOQ of 500, pack size of 100, and a 7-day lead time. Placing an order for 800 units today (2026-09-17) results in expected receipt on 2026-09-24, preventing the stockout scheduled for 2026-09-27.

The order cost is $9,600.00, which is fully within the available budget of $20,000.00. Peak post-receipt storage occupancy reaches 38.70 m³, well within the node storage capacity limit of 200.00 m³. The order exceeds the buyer autonomy spend threshold of $2,000.00, so it will require standard buyer approval, but is completely feasible and policy-compliant.
